nodes.description: Private pause flag read by the whenPaused/whenNotPaused modifiers.
Address of the external NFT contract (IGolemsAndDragons) used for ownership checks, transfers and stats.
Address of the external reward token contract (IAncientGold) used for balance checks and payouts.
Global counter of currently staked tokens, incremented on stake and decremented on unstake.
Mapping tokenId => index inside the per-owner stakes array.
Mapping owner => Stake[] holding owner, token and staking timestamp.
Constant time-to-earn period (1 days) used as the reward denominator and maturity check.
Constant 15000 ether reward rate per TTE.
Constant health growth rate (10, tripled for dragons).
Constant attack growth rate.
Constant defense growth rate.
Constant agility growth rate.
UUPS constructor that marks the implementation contract as initialized.
Initializer wiring Ownable and UUPS upgradeable base contracts.
Escrows caller (or golemsAndDragons) NFTs into the contract and records a Stake entry.
Loops over tokens, computes time based rewards/stats, optionally unstakes the NFT and pays out $AGOLD.
Owner-only setter replacing the NFT contract reference.
Owner-only setter replacing the reward token contract reference.
View helper returning the full stakes array for an address.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook restricted with onlyOwner.
ERC721 receiver hook returning the selector, entered on safe transfers to this contract.
Caller address obtained through _msgSender, attacker controllable.
Block timestamp used for staking time, maturity checks and reward math.
External call pulling an NFT into the contract inside the staking loop.
External call returning the NFT to the user, triggers onERC721Received on the recipient.
External reward payout executed at the end of claimFromTraining.
External call upgrading token stats with values derived from elapsed time.
Reward computation ((block.timestamp - stake.time) * EARNINGS_RATE) / TTE and per-stat time math.
In-place mutation decrementing totalTokensStaked during unstake.
ownerOf/isDragon/balanceOf external calls whose results drive checks and amounts.
Upgrade path performing delegatecall to the new implementation via _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
address_ parameter of startTrainingTokens selecting the stake owner array.
tokens calldata array of startTrainingTokens.
tokens calldata array of claimFromTraining.
unstake boolean flag selecting the unstake branch of claimFromTraining.
contract_ address parameter of setGolemsAndDragons.
contract_ address parameter of setAncientGold.
user address parameter of getAllStakes.
newImplementation address parameter of _authorizeUpgrade.
Accumulated reward amount per claim loop, later capped and paid out.
Memory copy of the Stake struct being processed.
Health rate chosen depending on isDragon (HEALTH_RATE * 3 or HEALTH_RATE).
Computed health growth value cast to uint16.
Computed attack growth value cast to uint16.
Computed defense growth value cast to uint16.
Computed agility growth value cast to uint16.
Last element of stakes array used for swap-and-pop removal on unstake.
Reward token contract balance used to cap earnings.
Loop counter used in the staking and claiming loops.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against address_ and golemsAndDragons in the startTrainingTokens guard.
claimFromTraining indexes stakes[_msgSender()] so the caller selects which stake array is read and written.
block.timestamp determines maturity check and reward amounts (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp minus stake.time drives the earnings and stat arithmetic.
block.timestamp is truncated to uint80 and stored as Stake.time.
address_ parameter selects the owner array written by startTrainingTokens.
tokens calldata array bounds the staking loop iterations.
tokens[i] is forwarded as the tokenId argument of transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the from_ argument of the escrow transferFrom call.
startTrainingTokens performs an external NFT transferFrom call inside its loop after partial bookkeeping.
totalTokensStaked is incremented for each staked token.
stakeIndices is written with the new array position.
A new Stake struct is pushed into stakes[address_].
transferFrom is invoked on the configured golemsAndDragons contract.
tokens calldata array bounds the claim loop iterations.
unstake flag selects the unstake versus restake branch.
stakeIndices[tokens[i]] locates the stake entry to process.
stakes[_msgSender()] storage array is read and rewritten during the claim.
Stake memory copy is loaded from the stakes mapping.
stake.owner and stake.time feed the ownership require and the reward math.
earnings accumulator is summed across loop iterations.
claimFromTraining computes time based earnings and stat values.
TTE constant is the division denominator of the reward math.
EARNINGS_RATE constant multiplies the elapsed time.
HEALTH_RATE constant feeds actualHealthRate (tripled for dragons).
actualHealthRate multiplies elapsed time to produce the health amount.
ATTACK_RATE constant feeds the attack amount.
DEFENSE_RATE constant feeds the defense amount.
AGILITY_RATE constant feeds the agility amount.
Unstake branch mutates totalTokensStaked arithmetically.
totalTokensStaked storage value is decremented in place.
Last stake element is read for the swap-and-pop removal.
lastStake overwrites the removed index before the array is popped.
safeTransferFrom external call returns the NFT during the claim loop before payout finalization.
safeTransferFrom is invoked on the configured golemsAndDragons contract.
addStats external call upgrades token stats inside the loop.
addStats is invoked on the configured golemsAndDragons contract.
health value is downcast to uint16 when passed to addStats.
attack value is downcast to uint16 when passed to addStats.
defense value is downcast to uint16 when passed to addStats.
agility value is downcast to uint16 when passed to addStats.
Reward token balance caps the earnings value before payout.
balanceOf is read from the ancientGold contract to cap earnings.
earnings is the amount sent out through the external bgTransfer payout.
claimFromTraining executes the bgTransfer external payout at the end of the loop.
bgTransfer is invoked on the ancientGold contract, transferring control externally.
ownerOf, isDragon and balanceOf external view calls are used for checks and amounts.
View calls are made to the golemsAndDragons contract.
View call is made to the ancientGold contract.
Loop index bounds the per-token claim processing.
Loop index bounds the per-token staking processing.
contract_ parameter is assigned to the golemsAndDragons state variable.
setGolemsAndDragons writes the golemsAndDragons state variable.

contract_ parameter is assigned to the ancientGold state variable.
setAncientGold writes the ancientGold state variable.

user parameter selects the stakes array returned by getAllStakes.
stakes[user] is returned from contract storage.

Upgrade authorization leads into the delegatecall upgrade path.
__Ownable_init sets the owner to _msgSender, i.e. msg.sender of the initializer call.
Constructor initializer modifier locks the implementation contract initialization.
_paused flag gates claimFromTraining through whenNotPaused.
ERC721 safeTransferFrom to a contract recipient triggers onERC721Received.
External bgTransfer call can re-enter claimFromTraining before state and payout settle.
safeTransferFrom recipient callback can re-enter claimFromTraining during the loop.

normalization_plan.reason: address_ is only used to select the stakes array inside startTrainingTokens.
tokens calldata only drives the staking loop of startTrainingTokens.
tokens calldata only drives the claim loop of claimFromTraining.
unstake only selects the branch executed inside claimFromTraining.
contract_ is only assigned to the golemsAndDragons state variable in this setter.
contract_ is only assigned to the ancientGold state variable in this setter.
user only indexes the stakes mapping returned by getAllStakes.
newImplementation is only consumed by the owner-guarded upgrade hook.
earnings is a loop-local accumulator inside claimFromTraining.
stake is a memory copy of the Stake struct processed in claimFromTraining.
actualHealthRate is a transient rate selection used only inside claimFromTraining.
health is computed solely to be passed as the addStats health argument.
attack is computed solely to be passed as the addStats attack argument.
defense is computed solely to be passed as the addStats defense argument.
agility is computed solely to be passed as the addStats agility argument.
lastStake is only used for the swap-and-pop removal inside claimFromTraining.
balance caps the amount passed to the bgTransfer payout.
the loop index is a transient counter shared by the staking and claim loops.
